title: No Leaf Decay
description: A server plugin that allows for the disabling of leaf decaying.
body:
Here’s a clean Modrinth description you can use:

**NoLeavesDecay** is a simple lightweight plugin that stops leaves from naturally decaying in all worlds.

It is meant for servers that want to preserve custom builds, trees, forests, spawn areas, and decorative landscaping without leaves disappearing over time. This makes it useful for hubs, RPG areas, creative servers, adventure maps, and any world where you want leaves to stay exactly how they were built.

The plugin includes simple commands to turn leaf decay blocking on or off at any time, check the current status, and reload the config. It also supports a permission node so you can control command access with permission plugins like LuckPerms.

**Features:**

* Disables natural leaf decay in all worlds
* Lightweight and straightforward
* Toggle leaf decay blocking with commands
* Status and reload commands included
* LuckPerms-friendly permission node
* Good for hubs, spawn builds, decorative maps, and protected environments

**Commands:**

* `/leafdecay`
* `/leaf`
* `/nld`

**Permission:**

* `noleavesdecay.command`

If you want, I can also make you a shorter “catchier” Modrinth description plus a separate full long description.
